findings.claim: ADR-0004 decision #4 deletes every per-agent SKILL.md, including configs/copilot-cli/skills/context-mode/SKILL.md, and replaces all routing text with the MCP InitializeResult.instructions field. But the ADR's own support table marks Copilot CLI as only 'probable (github/copilot-cli#1579 closed as completed); no source check' for honoring instructions — the weakest confidence level next to 'no evidence'. v1's own commit history for this exact file shows the opposite: the skill-based channel was built, found broken once, fixed, and verified end-to-end on real hardware, which the ADR does not cite or weigh against the unverified replacement.
findings.evidence: ADR-0004:34 '**Copilot CLI:** probable (github/copilot-cli#1579 closed as completed); no source check.' versus cm-main commit 9f34c6f1 body: 'feat(copilot-cli): ship a GitHub Copilot CLI plugin bundle (MCP + skill, phase 1)' ... 'docs: correct GitHub Copilot CLI plugin capability (plugins DO support MCP + hooks) — The README + platform-support docs claimed Copilot CLI plugins register only skills/agents — not MCP servers or hooks. Thats wrong: copilot plugin --help and copilot mcp --help (Copilot CLI 1.x) confirm a plugin can register MCP servers ... and hooks' and later 'Verified e2e on real Copilot CLI 1.0.60 via the documented plugin install'. v1 shipped and verified the skill file as the working routing channel for this exact host; ADR-0004 proposes removing that verified channel and replacing it with a field ('probable', 'no source check') nobody has checked against a real Copilot CLI session.
findings.fix: Before deleting configs/copilot-cli/skills/context-mode/SKILL.md, run the same kind of live probe v1 already ran once (copilot plugin install ... then inspect what system-prompt text the model actually receives) to confirm Copilot CLI 1.x honors InitializeResult.instructions. If it does not, Copilot CLI must keep a routing channel (tool descriptions alone, per ADR-0004's own fallback logic for Codex, or the skill file) rather than silently losing all routing text under the new decision. Update the ADR-0004 table row from 'probable/no source check' to a verified value before the deletion lands, and cite this archaeology so the correction is not re-discovered later as a regression.
findings.archaeology: INTRODUCED_BY 9f34c6f1 2026-06-21 'Add GitHub Copilot CLI + Antigravity CLI (agy) support' (#787), with an explicit internal correction sub-commit 'docs: correct GitHub Copilot CLI plugin capability (plugins DO support MCP + hooks)'. ORIGINAL_INTENT (commit body): the team first assumed Copilot CLI plugins only carried skills/agents, found that wrong by running 'copilot plugin --help' and 'copilot mcp --help' against real Copilot CLI 1.x, and then verified the full MCP+hooks+skill bundle end-to-end on Copilot CLI 1.0.60. REGRESSION_RISK: if v2 deletes the skill file on the strength of an unverified 'probable' instructions claim and Copilot CLI does not pass `instructions` to the model, Copilot CLI users get zero routing text post-migration — a worse outcome than v1, which this history shows was reached only after a prior wrong assumption was caught and fixed with a live check. SAFE_FIX_CONSTRAINTS: do not delete the skill-based channel for any host whose instructions-field support is not independently source-checked or probed; Copilot CLI specifically needs a probe before removal, not a GitHub-issue-title inference.
